dsDescriptionValue.value: Mobility VR Gaming: A Dataset of User Movements This dataset comprises user mobility data collected from 40 participants during VR gaming sessions. The dataset primarily focuses on the lateral and angular movements of the VR headset-mounted device (HMD) over time. It includes the following parameters: Record time (time): The recording time in seconds.Position (x, y, z): Displacement of the HMD position in meters.Orientation (yaw, pitch, roll): Angular displacement of the HMD.This dataset provides valuable insights into user movement patterns during VR gaming, enabling researchers to analyze and optimize VR gaming experiences for enhanced immersion and user comfort.

publicationCitation.value: Effects of Small-Scale User Mobility on Highly Directional XR Communications
